flags.problem: The chocolate-chip comparison makes the repetition of Ruth’s name in the story the joke. The way Scripture is written is never the joke.
flags.explanation: Dinah is a fair guess, but the text doesn't name her here. Ruth 1:4 names the two women: "…one named Orpah and the other named Ruth." I have a feeling Ruth's name is going to keep turning up in this story, like chocolate chips in a good batch. Hold onto it, baker.

flags.problem: The joke about wheat sitting this one out uses a food not mentioned in the passage.
flags.explanation: Wheat is a good guess, but this verse names a different grain. Ruth 1:22 says, "…they arrived in Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest." Barley, baker. Wheat just has to sit this one out.
